plan.summary: Opening the store now removes a stale lock file left by a crashed process. `clear_stale_lock` in `src/store.rs` was a no-op. It now deletes the lock file. It ignores a missing file and returns any other I/O error.
plan.riskRationale: One small function changes. Errors other than NotFound are returned. No tests appear in the diff. The change deletes a file, so the lock check matters.
plan.storyArc: One change: `clear_stale_lock` goes from a no-op to a real removal with defined error handling.

topics.title: Remove stale lock file, ignoring a missing one
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `clear_stale_lock` do now, and which errors does it return? Verify how callers use it and whether `lock_path` is correct. Check that deleting a lock held by a live process is not possible.
